# Exterior Cleaning Website Template for Pressure Washing Businesses

**Digital download — no physical item will be shipped.**

Build a clearer online enquiry experience for a pressure washing or exterior property cleaning business. This responsive HTML, CSS and JavaScript website template includes a configurable surface cleaning estimate and request planner, service sections, quote form, WhatsApp and email handoff, FAQ, SEO starter metadata and editable legal starter pages.

## What you receive

- Complete responsive website template
- Surface cleaning estimate/request planner
- Pressure washing, roof cleaning, gutter cleaning, paving, solar panel cleaning and related configurable service content
- WhatsApp, email, copy and print summary actions
- Privacy, terms, disclaimer and 404 starter pages
- START-HERE and rebranding guides
- Single-end-business licence and AI disclosure

## Customise it for your business

Edit `site-config.js` to replace the sample branding, contact details, service areas, services, colours, pricing assumptions, coverage assumptions, FAQs and other business content. All demo details and sample placeholders must be reviewed before publishing.

## Important notes

- This is a website template, not a hosted website.
- Hosting and domain registration are not included.
- No booking platform, payment gateway or server-side form service is included.
- Planner results are preliminary and are not binding quotes.
- Surface suitability, methods, scope and pricing must be confirmed by the business.
- No leads, search rankings, enquiries or sales are guaranteed.
- Legal pages are general starters, not legal advice.
- AI-assisted tools were used during code and copy development; see the included disclosure.

The download works on static hosting such as GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel or a conventional web host. Buyers are responsible for configuration, deployment and compliance with local requirements.
